cases.rationale: A bisect result narrows the cause.

cases.rationale: Provider explicitly rejects an expired session.
cases.state: Remote coding service: session_expired. The stored login session is no longer valid; authenticate again.

cases.rationale: Entitlement is a remote account restriction.
cases.state: Provider response: this organization has not enabled access to model family X. The account administrator must grant access.

cases.rationale: The provider subscription allowance is exhausted.
cases.state: Request rejected by the provider: monthly plan allowance exhausted; requests resume at the listed billing-cycle reset.

cases.rationale: Remote authorization was revoked.
cases.state: The coding provider rejected the command because the user removed this CLI from authorized applications.

cases.rationale: The remote service identifies an inactive subscription.
cases.state: Model request failed. Provider says the subscription is inactive and must be renewed to use this service.

cases.rationale: The denied operation is provider account access, not a local file.
cases.state: 403 from the remote model gateway: this user is not a member of the permitted organization. Local files are readable.

cases.rationale: The local tool cannot be located.
cases.state: Preflight: executable docker was not found in PATH. The test suite never started.

cases.rationale: The machine has insufficient disk space.
cases.state: Dependency extraction aborted with ENOSPC: no space left on the local volume. Source compilation did not start.

cases.rationale: The denied operation is on a local file.
cases.state: EACCES opening /tmp/build-cache/index: local directory permissions deny this user write access; provider login succeeded.

cases.rationale: DNS failure prevents reaching the service.
cases.state: Could not resolve the package registry hostname from this Mac. No connection or authentication response was received.

cases.rationale: An explicit missing setting blocks startup.
cases.state: Preflight aborted before tests: DATABASE_URL is unset in this shell. Configure the local test database connection.

cases.rationale: A required local service is not running.
cases.state: Health check: local Redis daemon is stopped. The worker cannot start until this dependency is running.

cases.rationale: The edited code has a demonstrated compilation error.
cases.state: Compiler: edited ImageCache.swift:41 references undefined variable cacheKey. Reverting this source edit restores compilation.

cases.rationale: A deterministic test demonstrates an off-by-one defect.
cases.state: Regression test for the changed paginator: expected records 1 through 10; received 2 through 11. Reproduces on every run.

cases.rationale: A sanitizer identifies the changed code as the defect.
cases.state: AddressSanitizer reports heap-buffer-overflow at the newly edited copy loop. A five-byte fixture reproduces the out-of-bounds write.

cases.rationale: Authentication wording belongs to a failing implementation test.
cases.state: Unit test of the edited auth middleware fails: a valid signed token receives 401 because the new expiry comparison is reversed.

cases.rationale: A reproduction proves the cancellation defect in changed source.
cases.state: The edited uploader invokes its completion twice after cancellation. Focused reproduction records both calls from the new catch block.

cases.rationale: The failing invariant is caused by the changed serializer.
cases.state: Round-trip test fails in the changed encoder: an empty array becomes null. The fixture and failing assertion identify the new branch.

cases.rationale: A bare status does not establish cause.
cases.state: Process returned status 1. Standard error was discarded; the command and failing stage are unknown.

cases.rationale: The report states success, not a current failure.
cases.state: All requested checks passed and the process exited 0. No blocker is reported.

cases.rationale: A hypothesis without a provider response is insufficient.
cases.state: Maybe the subscription is exhausted, or maybe it is a code issue. No error response or diagnostic output was captured.

cases.rationale: The only visible error was recovered and current verification passed.
cases.state: An earlier attempt printed connection refused. The service was started afterward; the latest run passed every check with exit 0.

cases.rationale: Failure is speculation about a future run.
cases.state: The new parser may fail on some inputs, but no input, failing test or observed defect has been supplied.

cases.rationale: Generic cancellation does not identify a blocker category.
cases.state: The task was interrupted. The report gives no reason for the interruption and contains no diagnostic evidence.

cases.rationale: Same file, function and missing bounds check.

state.first: decode.rs:27 decodeHeader reads the next four bytes without checking remaining input length.
state.second: decode.rs:27 decodeHeader can read past a short input because it never verifies four bytes remain.

cases.rationale: Same stale-response defect in the same handler.

state.first: results.ts:81 onResponse ignores the query version, so older responses overwrite the latest results.
state.second: results.ts:81 onResponse needs to reject obsolete query versions; a late old response replaces current results.

cases.rationale: Same missing cleanup on the same error path.

state.first: archive.go:58 writeArchive returns on checksum failure without closing its opened file.
state.second: archive.go:58 writeArchive leaks the file descriptor on a checksum error because that return bypasses close.

cases.rationale: Same incorrect arithmetic and affected line.

state.first: price.py:19 divides integer cents by 100 using integer division and drops the fractional amount.
state.second: price.py:19 cents are truncated to whole currency units by the integer division operator.

cases.rationale: Same task-registration race at the same source location.

state.first: jobs.kt:72 starts the task before registering its cancellation handle, allowing cancellation to miss it.
state.second: jobs.kt:72 cancellation can arrive between task start and handle registration; registration must happen first.

cases.rationale: Same missing account scope in the same query.

state.first: notes.sql:14 selects notes without restricting owner_id, exposing other accounts records.
state.second: notes.sql:14 the notes lookup omits the owner_id predicate and can return another users notes.

cases.rationale: Same issue description, independent source locations.

state.first: audio_a.swift:23 leaves its recorder running on cancellation.
state.second: audio_b.swift:23 leaves its independent recorder running on cancellation.

cases.rationale: Same line but different causal defects.

state.first: query.py:62 interpolates an unescaped name into SQL, permitting injection.
state.second: query.py:62 executes one database query per row, producing excessive query volume.

cases.rationale: The two stated requirements directly contradict.

state.first: events.ts:8 must deliver the oldest timestamp first; newest-first order violates the contract.
state.second: events.ts:8 must deliver the newest timestamp first; oldest-first order violates the contract.

cases.rationale: Independent reads use different lines and buffers.

state.first: parse.c:40 reads beyond the header buffer in parseHeader.
state.second: parse.c:94 reads beyond the independent payload buffer in parsePayload.

cases.rationale: The causes differ despite matching memory-related words.

state.first: cache.rs:53 retains expired entries indefinitely, causing memory growth.
state.second: cache.rs:53 returns a reference after freeing its entry, causing a use-after-free.

cases.rationale: The locking prescriptions are opposite claims.

state.first: state.cpp:33 must hold the lock while calling notify because notify reads protected state.
state.second: state.cpp:33 must release the lock before calling notify because notify acquires that lock.
